## Why it's still happening

The previous fixes (PRs #1068 and #1080) addressed **streaming** partial-tag withholding and two other malformed-open shapes (`<group:Name\n` and `<group:Name` at end of block). The string you saw — `
` — is composed of two shapes the parser regex still doesn't recognize. I verified against the exact regex in 2.30.0: it produces **zero matches**, so the whole thing renders as literal text.

The two gaps:

1. **Malformed open followed by `<`** — `

tree.name: Wrapping up` immediately followed by another tag. The open alternatives require `

blocks.content:
`, a newline, or end-of-block after the name; a following `<` matches none.
2. **Empty-name close** — `
`. The close alternative `</group(?::([^>\n<]+))?>` requires at least one character after the colon, so `

` never matches. (The strip regexes in `text-utils.ts` and `graph-helpers.ts` have the same empty-name gap.)

## Plan

One ~30-min task in the spec: add a `<group:Name(?=<)` open alternative, allow empty-name closes, fix the shifted capture-group indices in `groupContentBlocks`, drop the resulting empty group instead of rendering an empty row, update the two strip regexes, and write regression tests first (including the exact reported string). File a monorepo issue and reference it in the PR.

Please review and approve the plan above.
